# 设计点性能与方案权衡

_Design-Point Performance & Trade Studies_

设计点把任务需求、循环参数和部件能力组成一个可比较的方案。选择参数时既要看目标性能，也要把冷却、尺寸、重量、安装和使用条件放在同一评价框架内。

_A design point combines mission needs, cycle parameters and component capability into a candidate concept. Assess target performance together with cooling, size, mass, installation and service conditions._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先写清设计任务、工况、目标指标与约束，再比较参数组合。

_Define the design mission, operating point, objectives and constraints before comparing parameter sets._

- 说明提高压比、温度或涵道比时的收益与代价，避免只有单一最优指标。

_Describe benefits and penalties when increasing pressure ratio, temperature or bypass ratio._

- 把设计点计算结果交给非设计点与瞬态分析继续检查。

_Carry the resulting design into off-design and transient analysis rather than stopping at one operating point._
